# Twelve-word grid

Model: `word-grid`. Each call creates a complete slide. Inter, geometry and text sizes are fixed.

[Model index](../../../templates/MODELS.md) · [Palette and content guide](../../STUDIO-MODELS.md)

```latex
\studiosetup{palette=light}
\studiotemplate[variant=plain]{word-grid}
```

Palette switches are available only where the original composition exists in both colours.
Unsupported explicit choices fail. A global palette leaves special compositions in their native treatment.

## Variants and named fields

Use `words={alpha,bravo,charlie,delta,echo,foxtrot,golf,hotel,india,juliet,kilo,lima}` for exactly twelve cells in row-major order. Numbering is automatic; `numbered=false` hides the prefixes. Text keeps its fixed size and supports explicit `\\` breaks. The annotated variant adds grid-title, explanation-title, explanation, note-title and note.

## Complete one-slide example

```latex
\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{bitpolito-studio}
\usepackage{bitpolitostudiotemplates}
\usepackage[backend=biber]{biblatex}
\addbibresource{bibliography.bib}
\begin{document}
\studiotemplate[
  variant={plain},
  title={Example words},
  words={alpha,bravo,charlie,delta,echo,foxtrot,golf,hotel,india,juliet,kilo,lima}
]{word-grid}
\end{document}
```
